# NGU Idle Rust

> Engine that runs NGU Idle (Unity 2019.4) in Rust from the player's own game files, plus ports for desktop, web and PS Vita.

## Start here (pick your door)
- [README](README.md): what this is, player setup, legal notice.
- [Porting guide](docs/PORTING.md): create your own port (a new platform) step by step; ends with a checklist.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): work on the engine itself.

## Reference
- [Engine API](docs/ENGINE-API.md): what is public, stability policy, C ABI table, migration notes.
- Interface in code: `crates/platform-api/src/lib.rs` (`Engine`, `DrawTarget`, `Action`); real engine: `clr/src/session.rs`; C ABI: `clr/src/capi.rs`; build docs with `just doc`.
- Reference port: `crates/ngu-headless` (read `src/lib.rs` first). Port template: `templates/port/`, generated by `just new-port`.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [code map](docs/CODEMAP.md): components and files.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): commands and what each proves. [Fidelity](docs/FIDELITY.md): comparison with the original.

## Project state
- [Vision](docs/VISION.md). Work is tracked in GitHub milestones and issues.

## Rules for agents
- Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Keep the original game's files, extracted assets, saves and machine paths out of Git.
